title: Separate macOS physical RAM occupancy from real kernel memory pressure.
changes: Add bounded, read-only memory_pressure -Q and kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level sampling on macOS, with explicit method/provenance labels and nullable values when unavailable.
Keep physical RAM occupancy, effective free percentage and kernel pressure level as separate measurements; never label tiny os.freemem() as kernel pressure.
Add additive PostgreSQL diagnostic columns and owner-scoped history/cache propagation; legacy rows stay unknown rather than being backfilled or interpolated across method changes.
Use kernel pressure for macOS warning/critical states in Device Overview, Monitor, Fleet and diagnostics, while retaining clearly labeled physical occupancy.
Verify real Apple Silicon sampling (30% effective free, warning level), synthetic 99%/37%/warning UI cases, build/type checks and targeted unit tests.
Ship the public client/runtime release before any private server merge; no production data mutation or permission change.
